subject: Urgent approval: ZenWave renewal — concession bundle request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Ramanathan <asha@elara.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal notice — ZenWave (HZ-8932)

Hi Asha,

Quick note to confirm we’ve generated the renewal for ZenWave for the July 1 term. Current contract: $650,000 ARR, 12-month renewal. I attached the latest SOW (v3) and usage export for your finance/procurement review.

If there are any specific items procurement needs (pricing justification, SLA add-ons, or a short-term bridge), let me know — we can be flexible inside our approval bands. Can we get a target for signature by June 5 to avoid any interruption to your production workloads?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: ZenWave_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Asha Ramanathan <asha@elara.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@elara.com>, ZenWave Legal <legal@elara.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice — ZenWave (HZ-8932)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending — we reviewed the SOW. Two items are holding this up on our side:

- Price: Our procurement team is asking for a meaningful discount vs. list; we’re seeing a competing quote that reduces first-year spend by ~20%.
- Term/commitment: Given uncertainty on one product stream, ZenWave is asking for a six-month transitional term instead of 12 months.

If Redwood can offer a more aggressive first-year concession (discount and a one-time credit) plus an operational SLA guarantee for 12 months, we can expedite signoff. Otherwise procurement will push us to the competitive vendor.

Asha Ramanathan
Director, Platform Procurement
Elara Systems (ZenWave)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: ZenWave renewal — concession ask (needs exec signoff)

Team,

ZenWave (HZ-8932) is leaning toward the competitor on price. They represent ~$650k ARR renew — strategic account with 3 production clusters. Procurement wants a shorter term (6 months) + better first-year economics. If we lose this, they will move non-trivial volume.

Proposed concession bundle to save the renewal (preserves long-term upside):
- One-time credit: $50,000 applied at execution
- First-year discount: 25% off list pricing for year 1
- SLA add-on: 99.95% availability guarantee for 12 months (service credit ladder included in SOW)
- Term: accept a 6-month transitional term now, with an automatic conversion/option to extend to 12 months at renewal pricing if usage hits thresholds

Conditions we need from customer:
- Signed SOW + amended T&Cs by June 5
- Public case study + joint webinar within next 9 months (marketing coop $10k)

Ask: This exceeds standard deal desk band. Can we escalate for Marissa/exec approval for the bundle above? I attached SOW and usage that shows a workload profile favorable to caching/batching (keeps long-term unit economics solid).

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: INTERNAL: ZenWave renewal — concession ask (needs exec signoff)

Kim,

I reviewed the numbers. Preserving ZenWave is strategically valuable (healthcare analytics partner). The proposed package is reasonable but I recommend tightening the conditions so the concession is protected:

- Approve up to $50k one-time credit and up to 25% first-year discount, contingent on SOW signed by June 5 and a non-refundable onboarding fee of $10k to lock the price.
- SLA add-on ok for 12 months but limit the total service-credit exposure to 2 months of MRR.
- Term reset to 6 months is acceptable if we include auto-convert language: if usage >= 80% of prior 90-day baseline, contract auto-rolls to 12 months at agreed pricing.

Requesting Marissa to sign off on the above. If approved, Kimberly to send final counter to Asha with DocuSign link and conditional clauses.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer (on behalf of Deal Desk)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: FOR APPROVAL: ZenWave concession package (final request)

Marissa,

Forwarding the context and recommended guardrails from Vivek. TL;DR: ZenWave needs a better first-year cost to sign. If they move, we risk losing production load. Proposed final concession for sign-by-June-5:

- $50,000 one-time credit (applied at execution)
- 25% discount off year-1 list pricing
- SLA add-on (99.95%) for 12 months; service-credit cap = 2 months MRR
- Accept 6-month transitional term with auto-convert to 12 months if usage >=80% baseline within the period
- Customer to commit to 60-day notice before cancellation and to participate in joint marketing (marketing coop $10k)

We will require a DocuSign envelope with these conditions and the SOW v3. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/678900/HZ-8932.

Can you please approve or provide changes? We need an answer by EOD so I can respond to procurement.

Appreciate it,
Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: APPROVED: ZenWave concession package (conditions attached)

Kimberly — approved with the following binding conditions:

1) Approve the bundle: $50k one-time credit + 25% first-year discount + SLA add-on (99.95%) for 12 months.
2) Service-credit exposure capped at 2 months MRR. No open-ended SLA liability.
3) 6-month transitional term accepted only if the SOW includes explicit auto-convert language to 12 months when usage >=80% baseline; if customer declines auto-convert, concessions are void.
4) Customer must sign SOW + DocuSign by June 5. No retroactive application of credit if signed after deadline.
5) Require a non-refundable $10k onboarding fee to be invoiced on signature to minimize churn risk.
6) Legal to accept Redwood’s standard liability limitations — if ZenWave insists on expanded liability, concessions are pulled.

Please prepare the final DocuSign link and counter with the clauses above. Once I see the envelope, I’ll notify Finance to schedule the promotional credit.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Approval-memo-ZenWave.pdf (approval summary)
